e2e newDoc helper fix: waits for navigation to the new document
nodes.rationale: From an open document it did not wait for the new one, so text was typed into the previous document.

nodes.label: EditorHost (src/editor/hosts.ts) for DatascratchEditor

Web by default — notes only: spaces, notebooks with folders, notes, tags, favourites, search and ⌘K, trash, editor with pen, sharing and agents; tasks, calendar/daily notes, tabs (strip, overview, «Открыть во вкладке», ⌥T, ⌘⇧\) — extended mode

Inline checklists stay; in minimal build task dates are plain inert labels (EditorHost.taskDates: "inert", web-editor): date and «Переместить…» items hidden in task menu and «/», task actions (onTaskAction) not executed
Web «Создано агентом {agentName}» strip at note top; «Понятно» clears createdByAgent
API client timeouts (15 s / 60 s chunk) and GET retries; writes not retried (queued)
public/boot-guard.js boot guard (one auto-reload, then retry screen)
nodes.rationale: Separate file because CSP forbids inline scripts; replaces a bare stuck logo with «Повторить».

nodes.label: Session restore() bounded (4 s per IndexedDB call, 6 s total); splash offers retry after 8 s
nodes.rationale: Embedded in-app browsers can hang IndexedDB; never an endless logo, saved session not deleted.

nodes.label: Service worker precaches shell and all hashed /assets/* (~3 MB), cache-first
nodes.rationale: Some networks hang new HTTPS connections on TLS handshake; reload must not re-download.

nodes.label: Sync WebSocket closes if not open within 8 s; SyncClient reconnects
Resilience to bad network (hanging TLS handshakes)
Keeping CSP strict: /theme-init.js instead of inline script, zod jitless
@datascratch/web-editor (DatascratchEditor) with EditorHost (src/editor/hosts.ts)
Empty title auto-filled «Заметка 26 октября 2026» / «Note Oct 26, 2026» (defaultNoteTitle: word and date format by UI language, date = note creation day)
nodes.rationale: The editor fills it itself on Enter, when the cursor leaves the title and on blur; on closing a note with text the app writes the same title into the document because the editor is already gone.

nodes.label: New note opens with the cursor in the title; Enter in the title moves into the text (done by the editor)
Title fill done by the editor (EditorHost.defaultTitle, web-editor); app supplies defaultTitle, puts cursor in new note title (EditorApi.focusTitle) and on close writes the title via setTitleOf
e2e title.spec and unit tests title.test.ts for new note title
Web new note title (spec/04): cursor starts in the title, Enter moves to text, empty title filled by the editor
closeOtherTabs — «Закрыть остальные» in tab overview
src/lib/features.ts — the only reader of the flag (extendedMode, features.tasks / calendar / tabs)

Hidden by flag check: sidebar and ⌘K items, routes /tasks* and /calendar (redirect to «Все документы» in minimal build), tab strip and overview, phone tab counter, daily-notes notebook and tab tidy settings
«Недавно закрытые» — per device, per space, up to 20 (lib/closedTabs.ts, localStorage in try/catch); reopened tab leaves the list
TabOverview — overview via «+N», grid button or ⌘⇧\ (by e.code); on phone opened from tab counter in top bar; cards, search, grouping by notebook
nodes.rationale: On phone there is no strip, so the tab counter in the top bar opens the same overview; shortcut uses e.code so keyboard layout does not matter.

nodes.label: Quiet tab tidy (tidyTabs, on start and hourly): tabs unopened for settings.tabTidyDays (1/7/30/never, default 7, in «Оформление») go to «Недавно закрытые»; pinned, active and on-screen kept; missing openedAt counted from first run (ds.tabsEpoch)

Minimal build does not write tabs, activeTabBySpace, dailyNotebookBySpace and does not migrate old keys — openTab, closeTab, migrateSpaceSettings, tidyTabs are no-ops (unit test minimal.test.ts)
nodes.rationale: Data written by an extended client stays intact, so switching builds never loses state

nodes.rationale: The open notebook (its page, folders or document) stays visible even when it is beyond «Ещё».

nodes.rationale: Full desktop replacement (D-02, D-03); web-app stream (D-39).

nodes.label: Master key in memory, sealed by non-extractable WebCrypto AES key
nodes.rationale: Browser never reveals key bytes even to site scripts; no key leaves except agent-mode notebook key (crypto.md §8).

nodes.label: Offline-first device data in IndexedDB via Dexie (spec/10): ds-device and ds-account-<userId>
Spaces fully isolated on web (D-48): spaceOfNote, starredInSpace, tabsInSpace, migrateSpaceSettings
nodes.rationale: starred/tabs lists in account doc stay shared and the client filters them; activeTab/dailyNotebookId mapped once to their space and no longer written.

nodes.label: fitTabs — overflow into «+N» pill, active tab always stays in the strip
«Переместить в пространство…» — explicit cross-space move (note: space → notebook → folder; notebook: space)
nodes.rationale: Under D-48 the only way to move content between spaces; «Переместить в блокнот…» lists only notebooks of the current space.

nodes.label: Pinned tabs (pinned, tab context menu «Закрепить вкладку») — left, compact icon only, not closed by middle click or «Закрыть остальные»; openedAt written on activation at most hourly (openTab)
TabStrip — tabs of current space as a strip above the screen (outside <main>, nav with links and aria-current), not a sidebar section
nodes.rationale: Tabs share width and shrink to 128 px; close by × or middle click; drag a tab onto a folder or notebook; hidden in full-screen mode like the sidebar.

nodes.label: Pre-D-51 §12.6 tabs work preserved in branch claude/web-app-tabs-extended

Completely empty note (empty or only auto-filled title, empty paragraphs, no drawing — isNoteEmpty) created on this device in this session (newNoteAndOpen, «Новый документ» in ⌘K) is deleted for good on close, not to trash
nodes.rationale: Notes from other sources are never deleted this way: they may look empty only because their data has not arrived yet.
